{{Quote|My master taught me how to be swift. It did not save him, but I shall not forget his teachings.|Diala Passil|<ref name="Art of Movement" />}}
'''Shu Yen''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the mentor of<ref name="Temptation" /> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]<ref name="Veteran and Exile">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/10/27/the-veteran-and-the-exile|text=The Veteran and the Exile}}</ref> [[Diala Passil/Legends|Diala Passil]].<ref name="Temptation" /> He<ref name="Art of Movement" /> wielded a [[Shu Yen's lightsaber|lightsaber]]<ref name="Lightsaber">{{SWIA|set=Core Set|cardname=Shu Yen's Lightsaber|link=https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Shu_Yen's_Lightsaber|archiveurl=https://archive.is/IgmOL}}</ref> and taught Passil how to be agile.<ref name="Art of Movement" /> Long before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Shu Yen was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Campaign Guide">{{SWIA|set=Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|text=Core Set|}} {{C|Campaign Guide}}</ref> His death left Passil with [[Dream/Legends|nightmares]] that grew more intense as [[Time/Legends|time]] went on. At the location of Shu Yen's death, a dark and corrupt energy remained. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|evil force]] called out to Passil, stretching across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and haunting her every waking moment.<ref name="Temptation" /> When Passil returned to the place where her master died, she encountered an apparition of her master begging for her to come back before taking on the shape of Darth Vader.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shu Yen was first mentioned indirectly in the news post [https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2014/10/27/the-veteran-and-the-exile The Veteran and the Exile] on [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/index official website] on [[October 27]], [[2014]].<ref name="Veteran and Exile" /> He would later be mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' [[Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|Core Set]] released on [[December 15]], 2014.<ref name="Begin Your Assault">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/12/15/begin-your-assault|text=Begin Your Assault}}</ref> In the set, he is mentioned by name on the cards "[https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Temptation Temptation]<ref name="Temptation" />" and "[https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Shu_Yen's_Lightsaber Shu Yen's Lightsaber],<ref name="Lightsaber" />" as well as in the Campaign Guide.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />
